data.name: Tactician
data.description: As a standard action, a forester can grant the benefits of one teamwork feat to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear her. Allies retain the use of thisbonus feat for %1 rounds. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of these bonus feats. The forester can use this ability|3+HunterLVL/2
